name: reachable-app
description: Campus accessibility map that reroutes wheelchair, crutch and low-vision users when a barrier is reported or cleared.

paragraphs: A campus accessibility map. It reroutes wheelchair, crutch and low-vision users when a barrier is reported or cleared, and it never draws a route it cannot vouch for. This is the frontend (Vite, React, TypeScript). It is a working prototype for one fictional campus (Ashgrove University).
